description: This Java class 'AdvertiserService' manages Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertising as an Android Service, allowing BLE advertising to continue independently of the main app, with automatic timeout and broadcast of failure states.

classes.name: AdvertiserService
classes.description: An Android Service class that handles BLE advertising, including starting, stopping, timeout management, and broadcasting failure states.

classes.name: SampleAdvertiseCallback
classes.description: Inner class extending AdvertiseCallback to handle success or failure of BLE advertising start.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets running flag, and starts advertising with timeout.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by stopping advertising, removing callbacks, and updating running flag.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as this is a started service, not a bound service.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up BluetoothLeAdvertiser if not already initialized.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a delayed runnable to stop advertising after a specified timeout period.

methods.name: startAdvertising
methods.description: Begins BLE advertising with specified settings and data.

methods.name: buildAdvertiseData
methods.description: Constructs AdvertiseData including service UUID and device name.

methods.name: buildAdvertiseSettings
methods.description: Creates AdvertiseSettings with low power mode and no timeout.

methods.name: sendFailureIntent
methods.description: Broadcasts an intent indicating advertising failure with error code.
